description: This file is a Python module for the Stability AI Image Edit component. It provides a factory function to retrieve configuration classes for different models, and manages imports and exports related to these configurations.

classes.name: BaseImageEditConfig
classes.description: A base class for image edit configuration settings, imported from another module.

classes.name: StabilityImageEditConfig
classes.description: A specific configuration class for Stability AI image editing models, imported from local transformations module.

methods.name: BaseImageEditConfig get_stability_image_edit_config(model: str)
methods.description: Factory function returning a configuration instance for a specified model. Currently returns a common config for all models but designed to support model-specific configs in the future.
